# Assets and inventory: permissions

The asset inventory: assets, groups, types, owners, identifiers, relationships, services, components, branches, API specs, web endpoints and history.

- **CTEM stages:** scoping, discovery
- **Modules:** `branches`, `components`, `relationships` (the routes answer `403 MODULE_NOT_ENABLED` when the module is off)
- **Permissions:** `assets:components:delete`, `assets:components:read`, `assets:components:write`, `assets:delete`, `assets:groups:delete`, `assets:groups:read`, `assets:groups:write`, `assets:import`, `assets:read`, `assets:write`, `scans:execute`, `team:groups:read`, `team:groups:write`

## Who can do it

Built-in roles and role templates whose permissions pass each route. Owner and administrator are included where the route allows them.

| Permission | Roles |
|---|---|
| `assets:components:delete` | Owner, Administrator |
| `assets:components:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, Scan operator, Validation engineer, Threat intelligence analyst, Risk approver, Auditor |
| `assets:components:write` | Owner, Administrator, Member, AppSec engineer |
| `assets:delete` | Owner, Administrator |
| `assets:groups:delete` | Owner, Administrator |
| `assets:groups:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, Scan operator, Validation engineer, Threat intelligence analyst, Risk approver, Auditor |
| `assets:groups:write` | Owner, Administrator, Member |
| `assets:import` | Owner, Administrator, Member |
| `assets:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, Scan operator, Validation engineer, External tester, Threat intelligence analyst, Risk approver, Auditor, Executive viewer |
| `assets:write` | Owner, Administrator, Member, AppSec engineer |
| `scans:execute` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, AppSec engineer, Scan operator, Validation engineer |
| `team:groups:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, Auditor |
| `team:groups:write` | Owner, Administrator |
